incident: From Bing Search to Ransomware: Bumblebee and AdaptixC2 Deliver Akira (TTR ~44h)

sources.title: From Bing Search to Ransomware: Bumblebee and AdaptixC2 Deliver Akira - The DFIR Report (2026-06-29)
sources.what_it_gave: entry (SEO poisoning -> trojanized MSI -> BumbleBee DLL side-load), hops (AdaptixC2, RDP to DC + backup server, reverse SSH tunnel, RustDesk service), cred access (wbadmin ntds.dit, Veeam DPAPI, lsassy LSASS on multiple hosts), exfil (FileZilla ~75GB to Ukraine), impact (Akira locker.exe, WMI shadow delete), TTR ~44h

narrative_before: In a July 2025 intrusion (published 2026) the DFIR Report observed an SEO-poisoning attack: a user searching for 'ManageEngine OpManager' downloaded a trojanized MSI that side-loaded the BumbleBee first-stage loader (msimg32.dll) on a beachhead host, establishing C2. ~5 hours later the actor deployed AdgNsy.exe (renamed Windows Address Book) injected with AdaptixC2, ran systeminfo/nltest discovery, created new domain accounts with Enterprise Admin privileges, and installed RustDesk as a Windows service on multiple servers. On days 2-3 they used RDP to pivot to a domain controller and a backup server; they used wbadmin.exe to extract the NTDS.dit AD database (plus SYSTEM/SECURITY hives) on the DC, dumped and DPAPI-decrypted Veeam credentials from the backup server, and used lsassy to dump LSASS across multiple hosts. They tunneled RDP through a reverse SSH tunnel and used mixed-case command obfuscation. FileZilla (via RDP clipboard) exfiltrated over 75GB (file shares, credentials, SYSVOL) to a server in Ukraine. ~44 hours after initial access they deployed Akira (locker.exe), using WMI to delete Volume Shadow Copies.

detection_moments.description: SEO poisoning -> trojanized MSI side-loads BumbleBee (msimg32.dll) on the beachhead; ~5h later AdaptixC2 via AdgNsy.exe; Enterprise Admin accounts created; RustDesk installed.
detection_moments.evidence: 'the BumbleBee first-stage loader (msimg32.dll) was executed on a beachhead host via DLL side-loading ... deployed AdgNsy.exe ... injected with AdaptixC2 ... created new domain accounts with Enterprise Admin privileges and installed RustDesk' - From Bing Search to Ransomware, The DFIR Report

detection_moments.description: Days 2-3: RDP to a DC and backup server; wbadmin extracts NTDS.dit; Veeam creds DPAPI-decrypted; lsassy dumps LSASS across multiple hosts; reverse SSH tunnel proxies RDP.
detection_moments.evidence: 'used wbadmin.exe to extract the NTDS.dit Active Directory database ... dump and decrypt Veeam credentials via DPAPI ... employed the lsassy utility to dump LSASS memory across multiple hosts' - From Bing Search to Ransomware

detection_moments.description: FileZilla (via RDP clipboard) exfiltrates over 75GB (file shares, credentials, SYSVOL) to a server in Ukraine.
detection_moments.evidence: 'Data exfiltration was primarily facilitated through FileZilla ... Over 75GB of data ... were exfiltrated to an threat actor controlled server in Ukraine' - From Bing Search to Ransomware

detection_moments.description: ~44h: Akira (locker.exe) deployed, using WMI to delete Volume Shadow Copies across the infrastructure.
detection_moments.evidence: 'the deployment of Akira ransomware (staged as locker.exe), which used WMI to delete Volume Shadow Copies and maximize impact across the infrastructure' - From Bing Search to Ransomware

attack_path: SEO poisoning -> trojanized MSI side-loads BumbleBee msimg32.dll (T1195.002/T1574.002)
RDP to domain controller; wbadmin extracts NTDS.dit (T1021.001/T1003.003)
RDP to backup server; Veeam creds dumped and DPAPI-decrypted (T1021.001/T1003)
FileZilla exfiltration of ~75GB of file shares to Ukraine (T1048)
RustDesk service + lsassy LSASS dump; Akira locker.exe with WMI shadow delete (T1219/T1486/T1490)
ambiguities: Hosts named by role only; victim sector not stated. 'Multiple hosts' for lsassy/Akira modelled as srv_1/pc_2.
Report references a 'parallel incident' with BYOVD; not modelled as part of this environment.
Moments are the report's own timeline markers, not a defender detection timeline.
